With a Ryzen 5000 G-Series or 4000 G-Series CPU, PCIEX16_1 runs at PCIe 3.0 (spec page). The catalogue has no G-Series CPU.

Not on ASUS's CPU support list, checked 2026-10-02. The list has 76 CPUs: 17 Ryzen 3000, 19 Ryzen 4000 and 40 Ryzen 5000 models. Its Ryzen 3000 rows are the Ryzen 3 3100 and 3300X, Ryzen 5 3500, 3500X, 3600, 3600X, 3600XT and PRO 3600, Ryzen 7 3700X, 3800X, 3800XT and PRO 3700, and Ryzen 9 3900, 3900X, 3900XT, 3950X and PRO 3900, all "Validated since BIOS" 0303; no Ryzen 3000 G-Series APU (3400G, 3200G) is listed. AMD's Socket AM4 chipset page marks B550 "X" for "AMD Ryzen™ 3000 Series Processors with Radeon™ Graphics", and AMD's 3400G page lists "Supporting Chipsets X570, X470, X370, B450, B350, A320". ASUS's tech spec page has no CPU exclusion: its CPU row says "*Refer to www.asus.com for CPU support list.", and its slot and storage rows name "AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series/ 3000 Series" and "AMD Ryzen™ 5000 G-Series/ 4000 G-Series Desktop Processors" only.
